name: infiniai-copilot
description: An extension that InfiniAI API Providers into GitHub Copilot Chat

enumDescriptions: Pay-per-token billing. Uses 'infiniai.baseUrl' and 'infiniai.anthropic.baseUrl' for API requests.
Coding Plan subscription. Uses 'infiniai.coding.baseUrl' and 'infiniai.coding.anthropic.baseUrl' for API requests, with a separate API key.
infiniai.plan.description: Select the InfiniAI billing plan. When set to 'standard', the extension uses 'infiniai.baseUrl' and 'infiniai.anthropic.baseUrl'. When set to 'coding', it uses 'infiniai.coding.baseUrl' and 'infiniai.coding.anthropic.baseUrl' instead, along with a separate API key.

infiniai.baseUrl.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible API (Standard Plan). The extension appends '/chat/completions' to this value for chat requests (e.g. 'https://cloud.infini-ai.com/maas/v1/chat/completions'). Used when 'infiniai.plan' is set to 'standard'. To override, edit this value in Settings UI or add '"infiniai.baseUrl": "<your-url>"' to settings.json. Clearing a manually set value (removing it from settings.json or resetting in Settings UI) restores the default.

infiniai.anthropic.baseUrl.description: Base URL for the Anthropic-compatible API (Standard Plan). The extension appends '/v1/messages' to this value for chat requests (e.g. 'https://cloud.infini-ai.com/maas/v1/messages'). Used when 'infiniai.plan' is set to 'standard'. To override, edit this value in Settings UI or add '"infiniai.anthropic.baseUrl": "<your-url>"' to settings.json. Clearing a manually set value (removing it from settings.json or resetting in Settings UI) restores the default.

infiniai.coding.baseUrl.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible API (Coding Plan). The extension appends '/chat/completions' to this value for chat requests (e.g. 'https://cloud.infini-ai.com/maas/coding/v1/chat/completions'). Used when 'infiniai.plan' is set to 'coding'. To override, edit this value in Settings UI or add '"infiniai.coding.baseUrl": "<your-url>"' to settings.json. Clearing a manually set value (removing it from settings.json or resetting in Settings UI) restores the default.

infiniai.coding.anthropic.baseUrl.description: Base URL for the Anthropic-compatible API (Coding Plan). The extension appends '/v1/messages' to this value for chat requests (e.g. 'https://cloud.infini-ai.com/maas/coding/v1/messages'). Used when 'infiniai.plan' is set to 'coding'. To override, edit this value in Settings UI or add '"infiniai.coding.anthropic.baseUrl": "<your-url>"' to settings.json. Clearing a manually set value (removing it from settings.json or resetting in Settings UI) restores the default.

enabled.description: Enable retry mechanism for api errors. Default is true.

max_attempts.description: Maximum number of retry attempts. Default is 3.

interval_ms.description: Interval between retry attempts in milliseconds. Default is 1000 (1 seconds).

status_codes.description: Additional HTTP status codes that will be merged. Default is [429, 500, 502, 503, 504].

infiniai.retry.description: Retry configuration for handling api errors like [429, 500, 502, 503, 504].

infiniai.delay.description: Fixed delay in milliseconds between consecutive requests. Default is 0 (no delay).

infiniai.imageInputModels.description: Force-enable image input for specific model IDs. Supports '*' wildcard patterns (e.g. 'kimi-*'). Useful when a multimodal model doesn't include a name marker like '-vision'.

infiniai.disableImageInputModels.description: Force-disable image input for specific model IDs. Supports '*' wildcard patterns.
